title: Risk of Autism after Prenatal Topiramate, Valproate, or Lamotrigine Exposure.
abstract: Maternal use of valproate during pregnancy has been associated with an increased risk of neurodevelopmental disorders in children. Although most studies of other antiseizure medications have not shown increased risks of these disorders, there are limited and conflicting data regarding the risk of autism spectrum disorder associated with maternal topiramate use.
journal: The New England journal of medicine
